projectDescription: Modern internet-facing Azure platform built around Azure API Management, private backend APIs, event-driven integrations, and secure multi-region operations.

services.name: Customer Portal
services.deploymentModel: Azure Static Web Apps or App Service

nonFunctionalRequirements: Multi-region high availability and disaster recovery
Secure public ingress with WAF and managed TLS
Role-based access control and Azure Policy guardrails
CI/CD with approval gates and zero-downtime deployment
Centralized logging, tracing, and cost governance
notes: The platform should be designed as a secure external API platform with private service layers under Azure API Management.
Use Microsoft Entra ID or OIDC-based auth for end-user access and workload identity for internal service-to-service calls.
The architecture should assume a production-ready Azure landing zone with shared networking, monitoring, and governance controls.
